title: Breaking Free from Fear and Living by Faith
description: Get ready to be inspired by the exciting moments of faith and generosity that unfolded at The River Church of Kansas City! In this episode, lead Pastor Chris Zehner shares the thrilling story of a $100 cash prize giveaway and how it's a powerful reminder of the blessings that come when we give with faith. Join us as we explore the importance of giving back to God and how it can bring us closer to Him.
